content.title: Bank OZK price target lowered to $54 from $56 at TD Cowen
content.summary: TD Cowen lowered the firm’s price target on Bank OZK (OZK) to $54 from $56 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares. The firm views the company’s Q4 report as “disappointing.” Bank OZK reported a Q4 earnings miss but prior reserve builds should help position the bank to absorb pressures, the analyst tells investors in a research note.
